claim: chatgpt.com is the largest non-search-engine referrer (97/30d) and grew 5x AFTER the Cloudflare AI block went on, so do not claim the block is costing referrals. Facebook has collapsed to 22/30d.

body.note: chatgpt.com is now the largest non-search-engine referrer (97/30d vs 47 over the whole 6mo, so almost all recent) and beats Facebook (22/30d, down from 420/6mo). DAL-246 investigates, including whether DAL-188's Cloudflare bot filtering blocks AI crawlers.
